description: Demolition of existing houses, social club and some retail premises and the comprehensive re-development of Key Site 1 with the erection of a mixed use development comprising multiplex cinema, leisure and recreational facilities, town square, large retail unit, shops, restaurants, offices, hotel, health and fitness centre, creche, medical and dentistry centre, private residential, key worker housing, together with improvements to surrounding access routes, improvements to public transport including a new pedestrian link to Hounslow Central Underground Station and the construction of two new road links between the site and the High Street, and the construction of car parks, access and service roads and landscaping - details pursuant to condition 10 (tree planting) of planning permission reference 00616/F/P5 approved 31/07/2002
